On this my wife starts blaming me that I am playing gambling and started a quarrel with me. I was not having any intention to give talaq to her at that time of speaking these words. After that she said that it is equivalent to talaq bayen (i.e. one talaq). Than I said to her that I do not have any intention to give talaq. After that we both done Nikah (Ejabo-Kabool) without any witness. Now I have three questions: 1. Whether a talaq-bayen occurred between us. 2. If yes, was our Nikah that we performed alone is valid without any witness. 3. Whether Investing in shares of company doing halal business is better than doing a Fixed deposit in Banks. All arguments happened between us only. No other person knows. 1930 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 9444 Country: India Title: I said 3 times talaq in anger during fight to my wife, it was not my intention to give her talaq, I love her lot, we have one kid and we both don?t want be separated, we want to spend life together. We came to know after 8 days that she is pregnant, is we are not husband and wife now ? will my coming baby is not valid ? please help me. Question: I said 3 times talaq in anger during fight to my wife, it was not my intention to give her talaq, I love her lot, we have one kid and we both don?t want be separated, we want to spend life together. We came to know after 8 days that she is pregnant, is we are not husband and wife now ? will my coming baby is not valid ? please help me. Answer ID: 9444 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2473/2059=B/1429) Divorce takes place in a state of anger as well as pregnancy. When you gave divorce thrice in clear words, then now it will not be counted what intention you had, because divorce takes place without intention too if pronounced in clear cut words. Now she is no longer your wife, both of you should live separately. If you want her back you should have halala sharaee . The born baby shall be yours and will be legitimate. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
